description_en: Queries the log details of OpenAPI calls made by the current account based on the Request ID returned by the API, for troubleshooting purposes
description_zh: 通过API RequestId 查询当前账号调用OpenAPI的日志详情，用于故障排查
name: GetOwnRequestLog

parameters.description_en:
The RequestId of the log to query.
The unique identifier of the API request (in UUID format, and must be uppercase).
parameters.description_zh:
需要查询日志的RequestId。
API 请求的唯一标识符（UUID格式，且必须为大写）。
parameters.help_en:
